_comment: A small, curated set of openFPGA cores. Cores are made by independent authors under their own licences - this tool does not bundle or relicense them. Download mode resolves the core's GitHub release zip at install time (we do NOT hardcode brittle asset URLs; repository coordinates are stored instead and the latest/pinned release is resolved via the GitHub API). You can always download a core zip yourself from its homepage and install it offline. Core identifiers and repositories were taken from the community openFPGA Cores Inventory (https://github.com/joshcampbell191/openfpga-cores-inventory). 'identifier' is also the folder name created under Cores/ on the card.

cores.notes: Provides both Game Boy and Game Boy Color. The Cores/ folder uses 'Spiritualized.GB' and 'Spiritualized.GBC'.
Optional GBA BIOS is supported by the core but is not required and is never copied automatically.
HuCard support. CD support requires extra setup not handled here.
